channel.title: Indian Space Hub Store
channel.description: Official ISRO-inspired merchandise, apparel, scale model rockets, and space gear.

item.g:title: Not Lost. Just Orbiting. — Unisex Premium Oversized T-Shirt
item.g:description:
The Not Lost. Just Orbiting. Oversized T-Shirt is made for India’s space community—ISRO followers, space enthusiasts, students, engineers, scientists, astronomy lovers, and anyone excited about India’s journey beyond Earth.
Designed as a unisex oversized T-shirt, it offers a relaxed, comfortable fit for everyone. The clean front design keeps things minimal, while the bold statement on the back says it all:
Not lost. Just orbiting.
Because sometimes your mind isn’t lost—you’re just thinking a little further than everyone else. 🌌
Bold, classic and versatile. Perfect for a clean streetwear-inspired space look.
Whether you follow ISRO launches, dream of working in the space industry, study science or engineering, or simply love looking at the stars—this T-shirt is made for you.
Unisex • Oversized Fit • Made for India’s Space Community 🚀
Indian Space Hub — Connecting India to Space.
